    The easiest way to get started with pluginval is to grab pre-compiled binaries from the Releases page. Note that these are compiled with support for testing VST2.

    Once you need to debug a failed validation you'll probably want to build locally in Debug:

    git submodule update --init # grab JUCE 
cmake -B Builds/Debug -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug . # configure
